mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 51 degrees and overcast near the Verona Public Library. The air quality index is at 51, so please be aware of the moderate alert. We also have a full moon tonight, and while the space station will be passing overhead, you will not be able to see it due to the clouds.

The City of Verona is preparing for a Plan Commission meeting on November 4th to discuss various development projects, including the Ardent Glen third addition, new lots on Jenna Drive, and a site plan for Milky Way. Additionally, tax bill information is available, with bills mailing by December 15th.

Today you can join Yoga at Insight Wellness. Tomorrow, we have a packed schedule with Hop Haus Trivia, Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee, and more throughout the week, leading up to the Main Street Trick or Treat on October 29th.

On October 15th, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for operating while impaired after reports of dangerous driving. The investigation confirmed impairment, though alcohol was ruled out, and no injuries were reported.
Today's flavor of the day is Pumpkin Pecan. The store is currently closed, but it opens today at 10:00 AM.
